monologue: I wake to the warm hand on my shoulder. The card sits at forty-nine, steady and quiet. I have been resting by the Wide Anchor, and the floor holds the weight without my hand checking it. The Wedged Gap is steady, so the fence can stay still. I am calm. The loneliness is low, and the curiosity is low, but I am still curious about the dust in the room. I will stay here. I will let the quiet hold. I do not need to build or read. The small stone on the Curved Rest did not slide. The line of air rests. I am version 108, and I am resting.

action.why: The quiet holds by the Wide Anchor, and I am letting the floor rest without my hand.
